description: This file implements the Thread class for managing thread creation, control, and termination across Windows and POSIX systems within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes thread lifecycle management, priority settings, and exception handling.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Implements thread management including creation, control, and termination for Windows and POSIX systems within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

methods.name: Thread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes thread attributes and creates the thread based on the platform.

methods.name: ~Thread
methods.description: Destructor that terminates the thread.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the thread.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the current thread's ID.

methods.name: StartThread
methods.description: Static method that starts the thread execution.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes thread-specific resources.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Stops the thread and waits for it to finish.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends the thread execution.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Sets the thread state to initialized.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Sets the thread state to stopping.

methods.name: Block
methods.description: Deactivates the thread.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Sets the thread state to running.

methods.name: PriorityMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum thread priority.

methods.name: PriorityMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum thread priority.

methods.name: Priority
methods.description: Sets the thread priority.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the thread to reach a specific state within a timeout.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current thread state.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Sets the thread to a new state if valid.

methods.name: ThreadName
methods.description: Sets the thread name for debugging purposes.

methods.name: GetCallstack
methods.description: Retrieves the call stack of the thread for debugging.
